name: species
trans: n. (biology) taxonomic group whose members can interbreed; a specific kind of something

name: rare
trans: adj. not widely known; especially valued for its uncommonness; recurring only at long intervals

name: female
trans: adj. being the sex (of plant or animal) that produces fertilizable gametes (ova) from which offspring develop; characteristic of or peculiar to a woman

name: mammal
trans: n. any warm-blooded vertebrate having the skin more or less covered with hair…

name: reptile
trans: n. any cold-blooded vertebrate of the class Reptilia including tortoises, turtles, snakes, lizards, alligators, crocodiles, and extinct forms

name: amphibian
trans: n. a flat-bottomed motor vehicle that can travel on land or water

name: livestock
trans: n. any animals kept for use or profit

name: cattle
trans: n. domesticated bovine animals as a group regardless of sex or age

name: distribution
trans: n. (statistics) an arrangement of values of a variable showing their observed or theoretical frequency of occurrence

name: habitat
trans: n. the type of environment in which an organism or group normally lives or occurs

name: inhabit
trans: v. inhabit or live in; be an inhabitant of; be present in

name: territory
trans: n. a region marked off for administrative or other purposes; an area of knowledge or interest

name: nest
trans: n. a structure in which animals lay eggs or give birth to their young; a kind of gun emplacement

name: reserve
trans: n. formality and propriety of manner; something kept back or saved for future use or a special purpose

name: sanctuary
trans: n. a consecrated place where sacred objects are kept

name: conservation
trans: n. an occurrence of improvement by virtue of preventing loss or injury or other change

name: zoo
trans: n. the facility where wild animals are housed for exhibition

name: tail
trans: n. the posterior part of the body of a vertebrate especially when elongated and extending beyond the trunk or main part of the body

name: pattern
trans: n. a perceptual structure; a customary way of operation or behavior

name: jaw
trans: n. the part of the skull of a vertebrate that frames the mouth and holds the teeth

name: tongue
trans: n. a mobile mass of muscular tissue covered with mucous membrane and located in the oral cavity

name: mane
trans: n. long coarse hair growing from the crest of the animal's neck

name: teeth
trans: n. the kind and number and arrangement of teeth (collectively) in a person or animal

name: beak
trans: n. beaklike mouth of animals other than birds (e.g., turtles); horny projecting mouth of a bird

name: claw
trans: n. sharp curved horny process on the toe of a bird or some mammals or reptiles; a mechanical device that is curved or bent to suspend or hold or pull something

name: feather
trans: n. the light horny waterproof structure forming the external covering of birds
